collection.title: Mercedes-Benz C Class Estate 2014 to 2021 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Mercedes-Benz C Class Estate 2014 - 2021 (C205) model requires a 22" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is Specific Fit Mercedes-Benz wiper arm attachment and all of the following blades will fit. We also have the rear blade for this C Class, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
